v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Ecce in núbibus cæli * Dóminus véniet cum potestáte magna, allelúia.
text.en: Behold, the Lord * cometh in the clouds of heaven with great power. Alleluia.

text.la: Urbs fortitúdinis * nostræ Sion, Salvátor ponétur in ea murus et antemurále: aperíte portas, quia nobíscum Deus, allelúia.
text.en: Our Zion is a strong city, * the Saviour will God appoint in her for walls and bulwarks; open ye the gates, for God is with us. Alleluia.

text.la: Ecce apparébit * Dóminus, et non mentiétur: si moram fécerit, exspécta eum, quia véniet, et non tardábit, allelúia.
text.en: Behold, the Lord * shall appear and not lie though He tarry, wait for Him, because He will come and will not tarry. Alleluia.

text.la: Montes et colles * cantábunt coram Deo laudem, et ómnia ligna silvárum plaudent mánibus: quóniam véniet Dominátor Dóminus in regnum ætérnum, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: The mountains and the hills * shall break forth before God into singing, and all the trees of the wood shall clap their hands for the Lord the Ruler cometh, and He shall reign for ever and ever. Alleluia, Alleluia.

text.la: Ecce Dóminus * noster cum virtúte véniet, et illuminábit óculos servórum suórum, allelúia.
text.en: Behold, our Lord * cometh with power, and He shall lighten the eyes of His servants. Alleluia.

text.la: Fratres: Quæcúmque scripta sunt, ad nostram doctrínam scripta sunt: ut per patiéntiam, et consolatiónem Scripturárum spem habeámus.
text.en: Brothers: For what things soever were written, were written for our learning: that through patience and the comfort of the scriptures, we might have hope.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Ioánnes autem * cum audísset in vínculis ópera Christi, mittens duos ex discípulis suis, ait illi: Tu es qui ventúrus es, an álium exspectámus?
text.en: Now when John * had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples and said unto Him: Art Thou He That should come, or do we look for another?

text.la: Excita, Dómine, corda nostra ad præparándas Unigéniti tui vias: ut, per eius advéntum, purificátis tibi méntibus servíre mereámur:
text.en: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to make ready the ways of thine Only-begotten Son, that by His coming our minds being purified, we may the more worthily give up ourselves to thy service: Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
